messages.author: 452569198af8caee
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: h5 files format
parts:
I second the use of the Bioconductor package 'rhdf5'. I've used it extensively to open H5 files. For what I needed, this worked. It opened part of H5 file located into a group and created an R object.

hdf = h5read(path.to.h5.file, name = "/entry1/data")

You can identify the structure of your H5 file within R using the function 'h5ls()', but I found it more convenient to use HDFView, which can help you easily look at the data, metadata, and structure of H4 and H5 files.

Guillaume
